Frederiksberg is a Danish municipality evaluated in the clinical quality benchmarking reports published by the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK). As one of the 98 municipalities analyzed in the registry's annual reports, Frederiksberg's local healthcare data is used to assess the quality of atrial fibrillation treatment, specifically regarding the prevention of ischemic strokes. 

In the 2022–2023 annual report, Frederiksberg's data is included in the calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the incidence of stroke (apopleksi) events among atrial fibrillation patients using the DanStroke registry. The municipality recorded 19 stroke events among a denominator of 2,118 patients, yielding an unadjusted rate of 0.9 and a relative risk of 1.1 [^src1]. 

For regional benchmarking and local quality development, the municipality is grouped within a specific health cluster. According to the 2023–2024 report, Frederiksberg is organized under the "Byen" (City) [[sundhedsklynge|Sundhedsklynge]], allowing local health authorities to compare their clinical outcomes against similar urban demographics [^src2].
